summary_1line: Yudhishthira seeks guidance on duties; Vyasa directs him to the dying Bhishma, and after persuasion by Krishna, he prepares to approach him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vyasa, surrounded by sages, gestures toward the arrow‑bed of the aged Bhishma while Yudhishthira listens with bowed head.
Yudhishthira rides a white chariot drawn by sixteen white bullocks while Bhima holds the reins, Arjuna raises a shining white umbrella, and Nakula and Sahadeva fan him with yak‑tails.
Krishna speaks firmly to the grief-stricken Yudhishthira amid gathered kings and Brahmanas urging him to seek Bhishma’s counsel.
